# Dogfighter for Apple Silicon

> Free setup tools that run Airfix Dogfighter, the Windows game from 2000, on a Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later), from your own original CD. The project contains no game files. It is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Unique Development Studios, Paradox Entertainment or Hornby. The site also has a sign-up to hear when a new edition of the game is out.

Key facts:

- Needs a Mac with M1 or later. macOS 26.4 or later works best. Intel Macs are not supported.
- Needs your original Airfix Dogfighter CD and a CD drive, or a BIN/CUE copy of the whole disc. An ISO file does not work: it has no music.
- Needs about 6.2 GB of free disk space (about 5 GB for the game, about 1.2 GB for sharper textures) and an internet connection while you install.
- The game runs through Wine. Setup makes sharper textures on your Mac from your own game files; nothing is uploaded.

## Install

1. Install Apple's command line tools: `xcode-select --install`
2. Only on macOS older than 26.4, install Rosetta 2: `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`
3. Get the project: `git clone https://github.com/natemate90/dogfighter.git && cd dogfighter`
4. Copy your disc to a file: `brew install cdrdao`, then `cdrdao read-cd --read-raw --datafile Dogfighter.bin --driver generic-mmc:0x20000 Dogfighter.toc`
5. Run setup: `./setup.sh` (add `--language=French`, `--language=German` or `--language=Italian` for another language)
6. Play: `./dogfighter`, or double-click `Dogfighter.app`. If something goes wrong, run `./dogfighter --doctor`.

## New edition

A new edition is in the works: the same game, made to run on today's computers without the original CD. It is not out yet, and there is no date. The version on this site today still needs your own CD.

[Sign up on the site](https://dogfighter.net/#release) and you get one note on the day the new edition is out. That is all that is ever sent. A few optional questions follow the sign-up: which devices you would play on, where you would buy it, whether you would play online, whether you played the original, whether you still have the CD, and what the new edition should add or fix.

## Questions

### Do I need the original CD?

Yes. Setup copies the game and its music from your own disc, so you don't need it while you play. A BIN/CUE copy of the whole disc also works, but an `.iso` does not, because it has no music.

### Does it run on Intel Macs?

No. It needs M1 or later.

### Is the game included, and is this official?

No, this project holds only the tools that set the game up. It is for personal use with a disc you own. It is unofficial and not affiliated with Unique Development Studios, Paradox Entertainment or Hornby.

### How long does setup take?

A few minutes. It also makes the sharper textures on your Mac: one run on an M4 Max took about eleven minutes. The sharper intro videos are optional and made in a separate step.

### Can I play the plain original version?

Yes. Start it with `./dogfighter --original` and the game looks as it did in 2000. To leave out only the sharper textures, use `./dogfighter --no-hd-textures`.

### Where are my saves, and how do I back them up?

Your pilots, levels, photos and stickers are in `game/User`. Run `./dogfighter --backup` to write a dated zip file to the `backups` folder. To put the newest one back, quit the game and run `./dogfighter --restore`.

### Does a controller work?

Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch Pro controllers, and USB or Bluetooth joysticks, should work. Nobody has tried a real controller yet. Connect it before you start, and the launcher turns on Joystick in the game's Options.

### Can I play with friends?

Yes, over the network. Tailscale, a free app, is the easiest way and needs no router settings. Without it, the host forwards UDP port 19400 to their Mac in the router's settings.

### Is it safe?

Setup checks every download before it uses it. The sharper textures are made on your Mac from your own game files, and nothing is uploaded. Your game files are never changed.

### What is the new edition?

The same game, made to run on today's computers without the original CD. I am working on it. It is not out yet, and there is no date.

### When does it come out?

I don't know yet, and I won't guess. Leave your email in the [section above](https://dogfighter.net/#release) and you get one note the day it is out.

### Do I need the original CD for the new edition?

No. That is the point of it. The version on this site today still needs your own CD.

### Which devices will it run on?

I'm aiming for Mac, Windows and Linux. After you sign up you can tell me which devices you play on. That helps me decide what comes first.

### What happens with my email address?

When you sign up, your address, the time, your country read from your connection and any answers you give are kept on the Cloudflare server that runs this site until they are passed on, usually within an hour, and longer only if passing them on fails. They go as one entry into a Google Form that only I can see, and are then deleted from Cloudflare. To stop double sign-ups, the site also keeps a scrambled code made from your address, which can't be turned back into it, for as long as the list runs. I use your address for one email on the day the new edition is out and for nothing else, and I don't share or sell it. Cloudflare Turnstile checks that you are not a bot.

### Can I take myself off the list?

Yes. Write to me through the [contact form](https://dogfighter.net/#contact) on this page and I take your address off the list. To sign up again after that, send me a note through the contact form first.

### Something broke. What now?

Run `./dogfighter --doctor`. It checks the installation and prints a fix for each problem. When you ask for help, include the log file from the `logs` folder. Still stuck? [Send a message](https://dogfighter.net/#contact).
